def pos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':

            return (min(rows), min(cols), n['pixels'])
def N():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N': return n['pixels']
seq = (['UP']*4 + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE'] + ['DOWN']*6
       + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE'] + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE'] + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE']
       + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE'] + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE'] + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE']
       + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE'] + ['RIGHT'] + ['SPACE'])
print("start", pos(), "N", N())
i=0
for m in seq:
    action([m]); i+=1
    r = last_action_result; p = pos()
    if m=='SPACE':
        print(i, m, p, "N", N(), "lc:", r.get('level_completed'), "go:", r.get('game_over'), "score:", r.get('score'))
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP@", i, m, p, "lc:", r.get('level_completed'), "go:", r.get('game_over'), "score:", r.get('score'))
        break
else:
    print("seq end", pos(), "N", N())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
